verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI-driven email app with agents, so consuming external MCP servers is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence only documents Zero exposing its own MCP server (email tools reached with a session cookie). That is the server role and does not transfer to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows users can plug third-party MCP servers into Zero for it to use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
